second_optimization_15min.latency_method: Independent process, frame-correlated monotonic timestamps; every JPEG decoded at 1920x1080, no display/vMix timing

criteria_note: Conservative local acceptance: all criteria must pass. This is not vMix/display certification. No rounded FPS, duplicate frames, reduced resolution or lower JPEG quality.
limitations: Windows Qt offscreen, not Linux XCB/Xvfb. Docker engine unavailable.
Second run has explicit warmup, all 15 cities, synthetic full-size PNT assets and a separate process decoding every JPEG; first run used a simpler in-process reader and fixed cities.
Second renderer is bound to logical CPUs 0 and 2 on this Windows machine only; CPU IDs and affinity behavior do not transfer to Ubuntu.
CPU server and receiver are separate; original CPU included the reader but not JPEG decoding.
Latency is frame-correlated same-host monotonic timing to complete HTTP receive/decode, not monitor or vMix presentation.
Profiler stage percentiles are histogram upper bounds at 0.05 ms; stage nesting is inclusive.
Host CPU/memory and other applications were not isolated; affinity does not reserve CPUs.

host_observations.notes: Read-only host observation during the local soak; no system setting changed. CPU affinity does not reserve CPUs from other processes.

post_measurement_change: Diagnostics-only queue counter race guard. Painting, encoding, timing and all measured FPS/latency are unchanged. Raw soak replacement counter denotes attempts.
